property_summary: For a fresh contract, SetMinSum(v) succeeds iff the contract is not initialized, and on success MinSum becomes v; after a successful SetMinSum(v), a second SetMinSum(w) still succeeds (before initialization) and makes MinSum equal to w, proving SetMinSum remains enabled until Initialized() is called.

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `SetMinSum(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
